record.provider: Blossom server fleet (24242.io, blossom.oslim.dev / Lotus, blossom.nostr.build)

free_tier.stated: 24242.io 100 MiB/file, deleted if not accessed for 60 days. blossom.oslim.dev (Lotus): 100 MB/file and 8 GB per pubkey, retention 'permanent', cost 'free'. blossom.nostr.build: 20 MiB/file free tier, 'no limit on how many files, and no expiry'.

retention.stated: 24242.io 100 MiB/file, deleted if not accessed for 60 days

egress.terms: unmetered / CDN-fronted. nostr.build advertises 'Global CDN delivery' on free uploads.

record.tooling: curl; hzrd149/blossom CLI; any Blossom client. BUD-04 `/mirror` lets one server pull a blob from another given a URL, so replication is a server-side call, not a client re-upload.
record.chaining: aggregate GB is the sum over the fleet x number of keypairs (oslim's 8 GB is per-pubkey, and pubkeys cost nothing). 24242.io's 60-day access-based retention is defeated by any periodic HEAD.

limits.value: deleted if not accessed for 60 days

record.limits_note: per-object-cap 100 MiB on most servers (20 MiB on nostr.build free). This is chunk-sized, not object-sized. 24242.io caps /list at the first 250 hits, so enumeration needs date ranges.
record.reliability_note: small volunteer hosts, several with unstated total capacity. 24242.io states 'Free and unrestricted... for now'. Prefer BUD-04 mirroring to two servers per chunk.

evidence.proved: 'Free and unrestricted... with no warranties... for now.', 'Files are deleted if not accessed for 60 days', 'Max file size: 100MiB', 'BUD-06 /mirror will only accept a URL from another blossom server'
'Max file size —, Storage per user —, Retention permanent, Cost free'; README of 0ceanSlim/lotus shows max_upload_size_bytes 104857600, max_storage_per_pubkey_bytes 8589934592
'A hard cap of 100 MiB per upload (20 MiB for free uploads), with no limit on the number of uploads or retention'
agent report: nostr.download, 24242.io, files.sovbit.host and blossom.primal.net accepted BUD-06 checks at 5 MB AND 100 MB 'with a brand-new key that has never paid anywhere'

extras.unit_note: free_tier.unit is 'mixed' because the headline is denominated in MiB or KiB, which the schema enum does not carry; the verbatim free_tier.stated keeps the true unit.

free_tier.stated: No account, no quota, no total cap stated. 'Free and unrestricted.. with no warranties.. for now.' Per-file 100 MiB. First person to upload an object owns it (SHA-256 addressed).

retention.stated: 100 MiB/file; files deleted if not accessed for 60 days; /list returns only the first 250 hits; BUD-08 (NIP-94) not implemented

egress.terms: free, unauthenticated GET by SHA-256; served from a public host with no metering published

record.interface_detail: BUD-01 HTTP: PUT /upload (NIP-98 auth header), GET /<sha256>, HEAD /upload for BUD-06 pre-flight, /mirror for BUD-06
record.tooling: any Blossom client (nostr.build, ditto, Amethyst); `nak` for key generation; plain curl once you can sign a NIP-98 event
record.chaining: Content-addressed means a chunk map is trivial: `(sha256 → server)` is a complete locator, and BUD-06 /mirror lets one server pull a blob from another. So replication is a one-request operation per chunk.

record.limits_note: 100 MiB/file; files deleted if not accessed for 60 days; /list returns only the first 250 hits; BUD-08 (NIP-94) not implemented

identity_cost.detail: Anonymous. A Nostr keypair is the credential; no email, no phone. Verified: HEAD /upload with a BUD-06 pre-flight but no auth header returns 401 'x-reason: Authorization header missing, when required'.

record.reliability_note: 60-day access-decay retention makes this an ephemeral tier, not an archive. 100 MiB/file means ~5,000 objects per 500 GB.

evidence.proved: 'Max file size: 100MiB'; 'Files are deleted if not accessed for 60 days'; 'First person to upload an object owns it'; BUD-06 /mirror accepts only another blossom URL
HEAD (BUD-06 headers) — 401, x-reason: 'Authorization header missing, when required'
HEAD — 401, X-Reason: 'This needs a Nostr auth token (BUD-11)'
